title: 第8章 试百户之职第8章 意外之喜
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
在京城西城区那古老而庄严的镇抚司衙门内，当所有的锦衣卫们到齐之后，整个空间仿佛凝固了一般，静得连针落地的声音都能清晰可闻。
阳光透过屋顶的缝隙，斑驳地洒在青石地板上，为这庄重的场合增添了几分庄严。
孟望津面容冷峻，眼神如鹰隼般锐利，仿佛能洞察人心最深处的秘密。
他站在高台上，冷冷地扫视着下方站得笔直的锦衣卫们，那目光仿佛能穿透一切伪装，直达每个人的灵魂深处。
“昨天晚上。”
孟望津的声音低沉而有力，每一个字都如同重锤般敲击在在场每一个人的心上：“我们锦衣卫中发生了一件骇人听闻的事情。”
他的语气中充满了不容置疑的权威与愤怒，让整个广场上的气氛瞬间降至冰点。
锦衣卫们面面相觑，心中暗自揣测着孟望津接下来的话语。
李慕青站在人群中，他的脸色苍白，额头上渗出细密的汗珠，双手紧握成拳，紧张得几乎能听到自己心跳的声音。
当孟望津提到“昨天晚上”
时，他的心中不禁涌起一股强烈的预感，那预感如同乌云般笼罩在他的心头，让他几乎无法呼吸。
他低下头，不敢与孟望津那锐利的目光相对，脸上划过一丝惶恐之色。
“总旗李成器，身为我锦衣卫的一员，本应恪尽职守，守护朝廷安宁，却勾结魔教，背叛信仰，出卖我锦衣卫同僚，其行为之恶劣，罪无可恕！”
孟望津的声音在广场上回荡，每一个字都如同重锤般敲击在在场每一个人的心上。
他的眼神中充满了愤怒，仿佛对李成器的背叛感到痛心疾首。
“然而，天网恢恢，疏而不漏。
幸好力士江辰，识破了李成器的诡计，并将其斩杀，为我锦衣卫除了一害。”
孟望津说到这里，语气中透露出一丝赞许。
他看向江辰，眼中闪烁着赞赏的光芒。
随即，他话锋一转，目光变得严厉起来，他看向李慕青，声音低沉而有力地说道：“李慕青，李成器是你的侄儿，也是你的下属。

你作为他的长辈和上司，本应严加管教，防止他走上歧途。
然而，你却管教不力，任由他胡作非为，甚至包庇他的罪行。
你的行为，同样难辞其咎！”
李慕青的脸色瞬间变得苍白，他低下头，不敢与孟望津的目光相对。
“因此，我决定免去你一年俸禄，降为小旗，三年之内不得晋升，你可有怨言？”
“属下不敢！”
李慕青的声音微微颤抖，他深知此刻的孟望津正处于盛怒之中，任何辩解都只会火上浇油，让自己陷入更深的困境。
孟望津的目光如同利剑般从李慕青身上移开，转而看向了江辰。
他的眼神中既有赞赏也有期待。
“江辰。”
孟望津的声音低沉，每一个字都充满了威严：“你斩杀妖僧觉明，替锦衣卫揪出了内鬼，可谓功劳深厚。
现在，就由你来顶替李慕青的位子，你有没有信心？”
content_en:
In the ancient and solemn Zhenfusi Yamen in the Xicheng District of the capital, when all the royal guards arrived, the entire space seemed to have solidified, and it was so quiet that even the sound of a pin falling to the ground could be clearly heard.
The sunlight filtered through the gaps in the roof and scattered on the bluestone floor, adding a bit of solemnity to this solemn occasion.
Meng Wangjin's face was stern and his eyes were as sharp as a falcon, as if he could see into the deepest secrets of people's hearts.
He stood on the high platform and glanced coldly at the royal guards standing upright below. His gaze seemed to be able to penetrate all disguises and reach deep into everyone's soul.
"Last night."
Meng Wangjin's voice was low and powerful, and every word struck the hearts of everyone present like a heavy hammer: "A shocking thing happened in our Jinyi Guards."
His tone was full of unquestionable authority and anger, and the atmosphere in the entire square instantly dropped to freezing point.
The Jinyi guards looked at each other, secretly guessing Meng Wangjin's next words.
Li Muqing stood in the crowd, his face pale, beads of sweat on his forehead, his hands clenched into fists, so nervous that he could almost hear his own heartbeat.
When Meng Wangjin mentioned "last night"
At this moment, he couldn't help but have a strong premonition in his heart. The premonition shrouded his heart like a dark cloud, making him almost unable to breathe.
He lowered his head, not daring to meet Meng Wangjin's sharp gaze, and a trace of panic flashed across his face.
"General Banner Li Chengqi, as a member of my Imperial Guard, should have fulfilled his duties and guarded the peace of the court, but he colluded with the Demon Cult, betrayed his faith, and betrayed my fellow Imperial Guards. His behavior is so bad that he is unforgivable!"
Meng Wangjin's voice echoed in the square, and every word struck the hearts of everyone present like a heavy hammer.
His eyes were full of anger, as if he was heartbroken by Li Chengqi's betrayal.
"However, the Skynet is vast and there are no omissions.
Fortunately, the strongman Jiang Chen saw through Li Chengqi's trick and killed him, eliminating one harm for our Jin Yiwei. "
When Meng Wangjin said this, there was a hint of approval in his tone.
He looked at Jiang Chen, his eyes shining with admiration.
Immediately, he changed the topic and his eyes became stern. He looked at Li Muqing and said in a low and powerful voice: "Li Muqing, Li Chengqi is your nephew and your subordinate.
As his elder and superior, you should have strictly disciplined him to prevent him from going astray.
However, you failed to discipline him well, allowed him to behave recklessly, and even covered up his crimes.
Your actions are equally to blame! "
Li Muqing's face instantly turned pale. He lowered his head, not daring to meet Meng Wangjin's eyes.
"Therefore, I have decided to waive your salary for one year and demote you to a small banner. You will not be promoted within three years. Do you have any complaints?"
"My subordinates dare not!"
Li Muqing's voice trembled slightly. He knew that Meng Wangjin was in a rage at this moment, and any excuse would only add fuel to the fire and put himself in deeper trouble.
Meng Wangjin's eyes moved away from Li Muqing like a sharp sword, and turned to Jiang Chen.
There was both appreciation and expectation in his eyes.
"Jiang Chen."
Meng Wangjin's voice was low, and every word was full of majesty: "You killed the demon monk Jueming and uncovered the inner ghost for the Jin Yiwei. It can be said that you have made a profound contribution.
Now, it's up to you to take Li Muqing's place. Do you have the confidence? "
